base.kind: exact frozen C20 working-source endpoints, not a claim that the published PR HEAD alone has these bytes

composition: One insertion before the unchanged existing cfg(test) router; append-only additions to the existing dielectric_tests.rs. Exact patch is an increment on the two before/ endpoints, not an alternative full C20 assembly.

component_contract.work: Same caller-owned cumulative WorkBudget for construction and every step; caller must not replace/reset the ledger. No private work credit is created.
component_contract.cost: O((crossings+1)*(triangles+bodies)); incremental actual source scan, not BVH-accelerated
component_contract.memory: Fixed arrays/scalars plus borrowed references; valid setup/steps create no new containers. Existing invalid-options validator may allocate a bounded error String; compiled layout/RSS and future consumer admission are unverified.
component_contract.connection: one straight exterior-to-exterior segment, interval [min,max); existing ray origin/direction retained, lower bound next_up(hit.distance)
component_contract.errors: Existing TraceError InvalidInput/Internal/WorkLimit/Cancelled; no white/black success substituted for pending/errors; cursor terminal after success or any step error

integration_obligations: fresh exact receiver/API binding before adoption
independent source review is not execution
same cumulative work/cancellation and structured error propagation
component metadata/copies/retained capacity included in current memory admission
original component tests plus affected/dependent gate and real image/native acceptance
